data.name: RTSCTS.ToolTip
data.value: Enables hardware flow control on the main serial port.

data.name: SERIAL_SPEED.ToolTip
data.value: The maximum theoretical symbol rate of the main serial port.

data.name: ENCRYPTION_LEVEL.ToolTip
data.value: Sets the length, number of bits, of the AES encryption key.

data.name: FSFRAMELOSS.ToolTip
data.value: The number of output frames for SBUS or PPM missing before enters failsafe.

data.name: AUXSER_SPEED.ToolTip
data.value: The maximum theoretical symbol rate of the auxilary serial port.

data.name: btn_LoadSetting.ToolTip
data.value: Load all settings from the connected device

data.name: NUM_CHANNELS.ToolTip
data.value: The number of RF channels which the modems will hop through. Channels should not be less than 250kHz wide for stable operation. Not directly settable in region locked modems.

data.name: AIR_SPEED.ToolTip
data.value: The maximum theoretical symbol rate of the RF transmission measured in kbits/sec.

data.name: DUTY_CYCLE.ToolTip
data.value: The percentage of the transmission window time that the modem will broadcast for. Not directly settable in some region locked modems.

data.name: TXPOWER.ToolTip
data.value: The power level of the RF transmitter measured in dBm. Not directly settable in some region locked modems.

data.name: MAX_FREQ.ToolTip
data.value: The highest frequency of the modem operating band. Set in kHz. Not directly settable in region locked modems.

data.name: MIN_FREQ.ToolTip
data.value: The lowest frequency of the modem operating band. Set in kHz. Not directly settable in region locked modems.

data.name: OPPRESEND.ToolTip
data.value: Enables resending of data packets if there is an opportunity where doing so will not interrupt other operations.

data.name: RSSI_IN_DBM.ToolTip
data.value: Changes the values of the RSSI report from standard counts to dBm.

data.name: MAVLINK.ToolTip
data.value: When enabled the modem will preserve MAV telemetry packet structure.

data.name: LBT_RSSI.ToolTip
data.value: The received signal threshold level for listen before transmit behaviour.

data.name: GPIO2.ToolTip
data.value: Select from the available functions for GPIO2

data.name: GPIO0.ToolTip
data.value: Select from the available functions for GPIO0

data.name: GPIO3.ToolTip
data.value: Select from the available functions for GPIO3

data.name: GPIO1.ToolTip
data.value: Select from the available functions for GPIO1

data.name: checkBoxSync.ToolTip
data.value: Values required to maintain link with Remote will be automatically kept in sync

data.name: COUNTRY.ToolTip
data.value: Country or region that the selected modem is locked or restricted to.

data.name: AESKEY.ToolTip
data.value: The encryption key, in hexadecimal characters, used for encrypting the modem data packet.

data.name: ATI2.ToolTip
data.value: Identifies the type and hardware revision of the selected modem.

data.name: CURRENT_DEVICE.ToolTip
data.value: The connected device. Local being the device connected to the tools by TCP or COM port. Remote being a modem connected by radio link to the local modem

data.name: ANT_MODE.ToolTip
data.value: Determines the antenna behaviour of the modem.

data.name: MAX_WINDOW.ToolTip
data.value: The maximum time, in ms, that a transmission can occur for.

data.name: RATE_FREQBAND.ToolTip
data.value: A setting relating to region locked modems. This switches the modem between compliant frequency bands and/or rate settings
